_comment: Ported from RELICS in Parlour v23.dc.html (line ~1409). Dropped by elite sitters on win (Run.roll_relic). Both relics and marks populate the same runtime state.marks array as permanent passive bonuses — kept as two source pools per the original data, distinguished only by drop source and 'kind' badge color. `on` is where the mark is worn on the player's hands (scenes/Table.gd, mark_places(); added in the port, not in the prototype): index, middle, ring or little for a finger, thumb, nails, back, wrist, knuckles, or above for something held rather than worn. Left out, a mark goes where its kind usually goes.

relics.text: One more card in hand every reading.
Five centimes extra off everyone you restore.
